decisions.reason: The teaching-or-lesson standard does not change permitted sources or source-selection constraints; message 84's one-video rule is a separate, already represented decision.
Teaching a lesson and capturing a complete moment are independent standards; message 84 already separately represents the completeness change.
Requiring substantive educational value does not remove or modify the existing good-hook criterion.
The revised moment-selection standard does not change the existing 20-to-120-second duration limits.
Substantive moment value does not alter visual-editing requirements; message 84's clean and simple editing clause is a separate, already represented change.
The educational-value standard does not change the assigned eight-clip batch, which was already current before message 84.
The source decision concerns clip substance and does not modify caption color treatment.
The source decision does not establish or modify any caption-font requirement.
The teaching-or-lesson standard does not change the existing target of 180 approved clips per month; message 84 merely repeats that target.
